description:
DESCRIPTION:

T & J Gavigan are delighted to present this exceptional newly built A0-rated country residence, superbly positioned in the prestigious Kileen area of Dunsany, Co. Meath.
Extending to approximately 290 sq.m. (3,121 sq.ft.), this impressive family home has been finished to an exceptional standard throughout and occupies a generous site extending to approximately c. 0.22 hectares (c. 0.55 acres). Contemporary design is complemented by an attractive natural stone and rendered exterior, creating a striking yet timeless country home.
The accommodation is exceptionally spacious and thoughtfully designed over two floors. At the heart of the home is a superb open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining. The bespoke fitted kitchen features extensive cabinetry, integrated appliances and a large central island, while a separate living room provides an additional generous reception space.

The ground floor also features a large bedroom suite complete with walk-in wardrobe and en-suite, together with a separate laundry/utility room and guest WC.
Upstairs, the accommodation continues with three generously proportioned bedrooms. One enjoys its own en-suite and walk-in wardrobe, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a beautifully finished family bathroom with separate bath and shower.

The exceptional quality of finish is evident throughout, with bespoke fitted joinery, contemporary flooring, stylish bathrooms, recessed lighting and carefully considered detailing creating a sophisticated and comfortable home.

Outside, the property enjoys excellent privacy and space within its attractive countryside setting. A patio area provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining, while a detached garage offers excellent additional storage. A sweeping gravel driveway provides ample off-street parking.

Kileen represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial, energy-efficient new home of exceptional quality in one of County Meath`s most desirable countryside settings.

LOCATION:

Kileen enjoys a prestigious and peaceful rural setting in the highly regarded Dunsany area of County Meath, just a short distance from the renowned Killeen Castle and its championship golf course. Conveniently located for Navan, Trim and Dunshaughlin, the property enjoys easy access to an excellent range of schools, shops and local amenities, while the M3 motorway provides excellent connectivity to Dublin.

This is a superb opportunity to acquire a substantial newly built A0-rated family home, combining contemporary living, exceptional energy efficiency and generous accommodation in a highly desirable County Meath setting.
